title: He Almost Dug It Up… Then Grandpa Showed Him This 🌱 #shorts
description:
He planted one tiny seed and watered it every single morning. Nothing. Weeks went by, still just dirt. One rainy night he grabbed a shovel to dig it up… and Grandpa said: "Wait. Look underneath."

Roots grow first, where no one can see. 🌱

If you're working hard and seeing no results yet, this one's for you. Growth starts where no one can see.

💬 What are you quietly growing right now?

🔔 Subscribe to Fabelo Studio for more little ink stories with big hearts.

#shorts #motivation #patience #nevergiveup #animation
